invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$0.088755（入场价-3%），或Qlib评分大幅下降（如跌出前三），或融资费率Z-score超过100%（显示多头过度拥挤）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $0.088755 (entry -3%), or Qlib score drops significantly (e.g., out of top 3), or funding Z-score exceeds 100% (indicating overly crowded longs).
